title: Pickleball New Year Resolutions Shirt 2027, Funny Pickleball Checklist Tee, New Year Gift for Players
description:
The only resolutions that really matter. A tongue-in-cheek checklist for the new year: more pickleball, even more pickleball, and a couple of things we're still working on.

Who it's for:
- Players kicking off 2027 on the court
- Gift givers for the friend who never misses a game
- New Year's Day pickleball meetups

About the design:
Two ticked boxes and two honest unticked ones ('Learn the score', 'Respect the kitchen') in cream and lime lettering. Easy to read at a glance.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: 2027 Resolutions checklist design with ticked and unticked pickleball goals on a black tee.
